verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an official Terraform provider or any equivalent declarative config-as-code tool for Google Workspace apps, groups, or policies. It documents only imperative REST APIs: the Admin SDK Directory API, the Cloud Identity API (including dynamic groups), and SSO settings management. It also cites Apps Script for automating Admin console tasks. These are scripting building blocks, not reviewable, reproducible infrastructure-as-code for identity config, and nothing covers context-aware access or 2SV policies as code.
